notes.title: The Mystery Update
notes.content:
Hello again!

First things first, if you've been enjoying the game, please consider leaving a review! It makes such a huge difference and I'd really appreciate it! Thank you so much to everyone who has already left a review, it's such a joy to read them all <3

Now, on to the update! We've got a new challenge for those of you who have already mastered normal mode and [spoiler]reverse[/spoiler] mode: mystery mode! This time, you can't even see the letters until you've typed them. Good luck!!!

As always, the best place to reach me is [url=https://x.com/TTHewGames]twitter[/url]. Whenever another update is in the works, I'll post about it there.

In the meantime, thanks for playing!

notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
Hello!

First of all, thank you so much for playing Poetry Pigeon! It's been amazing to see everyone's reviews and playthroughs! Here's our first update, focusing on two of the biggest issues I've noticed people having:

[list]
[*]First of all, the game wasn't working on QWERTZ, AZERTY, etc. Oops! That should be fixed now :) If it still doesn't work for you, please let me know what kind of keyboard you're using!
[*]Second, I noticed a lot of people playing in pipeless just to see how long a level is, which you really shouldn't have to do. So now each level has a progress bar at the top of the screen so you can see how far you have to go
[/list]

More updates will be coming! The best place to hear about stuff in advance is on [url=https://x.com/TTHewGames]twitter[/url]! Feel free to contact me there or here if you have any issues!

Thank you all!
